rv.q: It has to be one of the most intense circus experiences ever.
But as a coherent hybrid concept… it’s at best a fun placeholder until Disney’s in-the-works stage musical finally rumbles over the horizon.
While creative director Simon Hammerstein has engineered a spirited experience, it lacks a knockout performance.
Come Alive! is still an extravaganza of festivity and spectacle, so prepare to be entertained.
It’s entertaining, energetic, immersive, interactive and fun for all the family – and there’s popcorn and pick ‘n’ mix too!
Go for the razzmatazz of the circus, do not go for a cohesive plot or discussion (or even acknowledgement) of the problems of colonialist theatrical forms.
Come Alive! The Greatest Showman Circus Spectacular is an immersive mishmash of circus, story and song that somehow manages to do a disservice to all three.
Come Alive will no doubt be a major success, both with fans of the film and theatregoers.
This is Cirque Du Soleil in a sparkly jumpsuit with a megawatt smile.

cn.t: Spectacular circus acrobatics and immersive staging dazzle, but weak plotting and awkward integration of The Greatest Showman's songs leave critics mixed on this big-budget spectacle.
